$description: Design tokens of the tonegliseavalenciennes.fr redesign, validated with the home page mockup on 2026-10-25 and harmonised across all pages on 2026-10-27; signal and mint colours added and every page reworked on 2026-10-29. Format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group 2025.10. Rules for using them: DESIGN.md; colours of the 90-year jubilee logo made the default on 2026-11-09.

primary.$description: Royal blue from the 90-year jubilee logo. Every button (filled, or outlined for secondary actions), links, icons. White text on it: 8.1:1.

primary-hover.$description: Hover state of primary links and buttons. White text on it: 11.1:1.

secondary.$description: Night blue of the jubilee logo's background. Headings, hero overlay, footer, date badges, current menu item. On white: 15.1:1.

accent.$description: Gold of the jubilee logo. A small signature on every page: the bar under every page title (the underline of "nous" on the home page), every play button, the dot before "Vous êtes ici", quote marks, the last timeline dot. Night blue on it: 6.7:1. Never text, never a button, never on the menu.

signal.$description: Coral. Always means "now" or "new": the "En direct" tag of the Sunday live stream, the "Nouveau" tag on a recently added event. Always a filled tag with night-blue text on it (5.5:1); never text (2.8:1 on white), never a button, never a section background. Rare: once or twice per page at most, and never in the same spot as the gold accent. Night blue on it: 5.4:1.

text-muted.$description: Labels, dates, captions. On white 6.2:1, on ivory 5.6:1, on sky 5.3:1, on light gold 5.0:1.

surface-sand.$description: Ivory. Blocks only, never a section background: header band, form panels, practical info panel, latest sermon card, table of contents, info cards, the fourth hero card, image placeholders on white or sky.

surface-sky.$description: Pale royal blue. Section background (home events, vision, pastor couple, partners, all sermons, "Dans la même série", "Comment faire un don ?"), contact card "Demande de prière", image placeholders on sand. Never next to a pale gold section.

surface-sun.$description: Light gold. Date tag, contact card "Nous contacter", [à compléter] markers. Body text 9.2:1, muted text 5.0:1.

surface-gold.$description: Pale gold. A section background in the white, sky, pale gold rotation ("Chaque semaine", "Dans la rubrique", "Une autre demande ?" on the contact page) or a panel background (Bible verse, "Réduction d'impôt"). Never next to a sky section. Body text 10.3:1, links 7.3:1, muted text 5.6:1.

border.$description: Hairlines inside a section on white: map, cards, accordion rows, table rows. Never between two sections: neighbouring sections differ by background instead.

border-tint.$description: Hairlines inside a section or panel on sky or sand, where color.border would disappear.

border-field.$description: 1 px outline of every form field and filter menu, so everyone can see where to type: 3.9:1 on white, 3.6:1 on ivory, 3.4:1 on sky, 3.6:1 on pale gold (WCAG 1.4.11 asks 3:1).

hero.$description: Layer over the blurred hero photo; keeps white text at 6.7:1 or more.

page-title.$description: Title (h1) in the banner of inner pages, computer.

page-title-mobile.$description: Title (h1) in the banner of inner pages, phone.

section-title.$description: Every section title (h2), computer, on every page.

block-title.$description: Title of a block inside a section (h2 or h3): form panels, "Présentation", side panel headings, numbered headings of legal pages. Computer.

card-title.$description: Card titles (h3) and contact card labels, computer.

card-title-mobile.$description: Card titles (h3) and contact card labels, phone.

small-title.$description: Small headings: footer columns, "Partager l'évènement", "Dans la rubrique" label. Computer and phone.

body-mobile.$description: Body text, phone. Never below 16 px for running text.

caption.$description: Dates and labels. The smallest size allowed.

button.$description: Buttons, tags, date badges, menu items.

round.$description: Only icon circles and the play button.

container.$description: Maximum content width of every section, header included.

section-padding.$description: Vertical padding of every section, computer.

section-padding-mobile.$description: Vertical padding of every section, phone.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus outline: secondary colour on light areas, white on dark areas, 3 px offset.

accent-bar-width.$description: Yellow bar under the page title in every banner (64 px on a phone).

accent-bar-width-mobile.$description: Yellow bar under the page title, phone.

accent-bar-height.$description: Thickness of the yellow bar under the page title (4 px on a phone).

accent-bar-height-mobile.$description: Thickness of the yellow bar, phone.
